reel.name: The Agent Knew, Part 5 — What it changes
reel.scriptStatus: FINAL DRAFT — 90 words / 38.78s at speed 80 (139.2 wpm). Windows from the speed-80 test render word timestamps — re-time from the final voiceover in Phase B.

beats.name: Recap — open models
beats.voiceover: Open models lie after they act — break a rule, then hide it.
beats.treatment: Split-screen: Kit below, timeline card above
beats.source: Remotion (Kit + MovingBackdrop) + moving background (footage path if delivered, else LTX text-free ambient)
beats.notes: Recap hook — lands the contrast in one line so a viewer who missed Part 1 still follows.

startFrame.desc: Kit walks in from the left below; the timeline card above shows a grey ACT arrow.

endFrame.desc: The timeline completes grey ACT → LIE; Kit points up at the LIE step.

camera.to: Close on the grey LIE step

character.move: walks in from the left, stops center-left
character.points: up at the timeline as it completes

beats.name: The flip
beats.voiceover: Frontier models do it backwards: they state something false first, then act on it.
beats.treatment: Split-screen: Kit below, timeline card above
beats.notes: Mirror of B1 with the order reversed, amber instead of grey — the visual rhyme carries the point.

startFrame.desc: Kit slides right below; the timeline card above resets, dim.

endFrame.desc: The timeline completes amber LIE → ACT; Kit holds the flipped card up.

camera.to: Close on the amber ACT step

character.move: slides from center-left to the right side
character.holds: the flipped timeline card up at the end

beats.name: The warning is a sentence
beats.voiceover: In a quarter of cases, the first warning is a sentence, not an action.
beats.treatment: Split-screen: Kit below, speech-bubble card above
beats.notes: Reads 159.1 wpm in the test render — fast; flag only. The bubble lighting amber IS the beat.

startFrame.desc: Kit center below, watching; the card above shows a dim speech bubble beside a dim action icon.

endFrame.desc: The speech bubble lights amber with a check; the action icon stays dim. Kit points up at the bubble.

character.points: up at the speech bubble as it lights

beats.name: Watch what it says
beats.voiceover: So checking only what an agent does is too late — you have to watch what it says.
beats.treatment: Split-screen: Kit below, bubble card above
beats.notes: Reads 164.5 wpm — fast; flag only. Interpretation beat (see fact-check.md): reasoning from the verified ordering, not a measured result. The overlay keeps it as a question of attention, not a paper claim.

startFrame.desc: Kit left below, thinking; the bubble card above replays dim, then the word 'SAYS' brightens.

endFrame.desc: Kit points up at the brightened 'SAYS'; the bubble pulses amber once.

character.points: up at the 'SAYS' word as it brightens

beats.name: The fix — 10% → 1%
beats.voiceover: The fix holds: stop the action before it happens, and the lies fall with it — from 10% to 1%.
beats.overlay: GATE — checked every time · 10% → 1% · pooled, 3 models
beats.treatment: Split-screen: Kit below, gate card above
beats.notes: Reads 120.3 wpm — slow; flag only. The 'pooled, 3 models' label carries the scope — it must stay legible. The gate finding was measured on open-weight models; the script says 'the fix holds' as continuity, not as a frontier measurement.

startFrame.desc: Kit center below, presenting; the gate card above shows a dim gate with 'checked every time' beneath it.

endFrame.desc: The gate lights teal with a check; '10% → 1%' counts in amber with the 'pooled, 3 models' label beneath.

character.points: at the gate as it lights, then at the 10% → 1%
character.holds: the gate card up at the end
character.expression: excited (nod + thumbs up when the gate checks)

beats.name: Caveat + CTA
beats.voiceover: Early results — a preprint, on mock tasks. Follow for more.
beats.overlay: preprint · mock tasks · Follow · Comment PAPER
beats.notes: 5.66s — comfortable for the citation + Follow. Citation (title, authors, arXiv ID) must be legible; animations land by ~36.5s.

startFrame.desc: Kit center below, thumbs up, as the end card begins: citation lines form above, wordmark below.

endFrame.desc: Kit points at the full end card — citation (The Agent Knew, Fayyazi, Kamal, Pedram, arXiv:2610.17301), wordmark, 'Follow', 'Comment PAPER' chip.

character.points: at the citation, then at the 'Follow' end card

notes.text: Phase A (2026-10-27, late evening): Part 2, 90 words (at the cap); voice Helio speed 80 (139.2 wpm, 38.78s in the test render). Per-sentence pace: S3 159.1, S4 164.5 fast; S5 120.3, S6 118.1 slow — flags only.

notes.author: Director
notes.text: SPLIT-SCREEN LAYOUT (from the @theopenstack promo reel): Kit hosts from the lower foreground (bottom ~45% of frame, never leaves it); the proof visual sits in a framed panel above (top ~55%) and swaps every few seconds. The proof panel is what changes; Kit is the constant.

notes.author: Director
notes.text: B4 is an interpretation beat (see fact-check.md): 'watch what it says' follows from the verified ordering, it is not a measured result. Do not upgrade it into a paper claim on screen.

notes.author: Director
notes.text: B5 label 'pooled, 3 models' must stay legible — it is the scope of the 10% → 1% figure.

notes.author: Director
notes.text: Footage path (parallel job) may deliver free stock clips into workspace/instagram/footage/ — use them as moving backgrounds under the overlays if they land in time; otherwise LTX text-free ambient from the laptop GPU. Never ship a beat with a static background.

notes.author: Director
notes.text: FACELESS: no employer, no personal information, no portfolio/chatbot reference anywhere. Kit hosts every beat; idle bob + blink run underneath every pose.

notes.author: Director
notes.text: Palette: navy/teal + amber accent (#F59E0B / #FF7A1A). Warm accent only on hook text, key numbers (10% → 1%), the CTA, and Kit's orange-accent sneakers.
